mnemonic: 마련 = arrangement (as in 마련하다): it's all been arranged in advance. That's simply how things go.
nuance: States what naturally or inevitably happens as a general rule, not what happened in one case. The 기 clause stays in the present (*실수했기 마련이다), though the whole can be shifted to the past (-기 마련이었다). Neutral in tone; used to observe and to comfort (처음엔 누구나 실수하기 마련이에요). Variant: -게 마련이다.

examples.ko: 아무리 친한 사이라도 오래 같이 살다 보면 부딪히기 마련이다.
examples.en: However close you are, live together long enough and you're bound to clash.

examples.ko: 처음엔 누구나 헤매기 마련이니까 너무 걱정하지 마세요.
examples.en: Everyone fumbles around at first, so don't worry too much.

cloze.en: Anyone is bound to be clumsy at a job they've just taken on.

nearMiss.hint: Also natural; the cue asks for -기 마련이다.
